# Ahmed Felfel

Ahmed Felfel is a product engineer based in Montréal. He builds learning
products, developer tools, and internal AI systems.

He currently works at Builder.io as a GTM Engineer. He joined as a Customer
Engineer, later worked as a Partner Enablement Engineer, and now works in GTM
engineering. He built software in each role.

## Selected public work

- Builder Academy: Ahmed built it from the start; enablement and content
  teammates contributed later: https://academy.builder.io
- Builder CMS MCP Server: built the initial production implementation:
  https://www.builder.io/c/docs/mcp-builder-server
- Agent Native: four merged open-source contributions:
  https://github.com/BuilderIO/agent-native/pulls?q=is%3Apr+author%3Apaprikaf+is%3Amerged
- @crate.ai/discogs-sdk: creator and maintainer:
  https://www.npmjs.com/package/@crate.ai/discogs-sdk
- Galite: early product for organizing meeting notes, decisions, and follow-ups:
  https://galite.ai/

## Technical range Ahmed publishes

- Product and UI/UX: turns unclear problems into useful workflows, clear
  interfaces, and testable first versions
- System architecture: shapes service boundaries, data flows, and tradeoffs so
  today's build does not block what comes next
- Frontend engineering: builds complete product interfaces with React and
  TypeScript, from component systems through application flows
- Backend and cloud: designs APIs and backend services with Node and Convex,
  then deploys and operates them across GCP and AWS
- Applied AI: connects models to tools and data with MCP, human review, and
  evaluation where errors matter
- Delivery and DevOps: sets up CI/CD, Terraform, logging, and recovery so
  releases are repeatable and systems stay operable
- Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Collège LaSalle, 2016–2019
- Fluent English, French, and Arabic; conversational Spanish
- Based in Montréal, Canada

These profile facts are Ahmed’s own published account:
https://paprikaf.com/resume
